correctionSummary: Removed shared mutable deterministic Design generation state, made timestamps request-local, and added fixed-time and controlled nested-request tests proving repeatability, timestamp isolation, exactly three directions, and disjoint generated IDs.

Distinct request identities retain distinct timestamps and direction IDs.
A nested request at generation start cannot overwrite the outer request's local IDs or timestamp, and complete generated-ID sets remain disjoint.
